thread:
Maya: quick follow-up from the incident postmortem. We need a slim action plan to reduce alert noise and lock owners/timelines. Focus: noise suppression, sensible thresholds, dedupe windows, and paging policy for transient alerts.

Ken: I'll own the caching layer alerts (cache-err-*, cache-hit-drop-*). Plan: increase error-rate threshold from 0.7% -> 1.2% for short windows, add 180s burst suppression, target end of week.

Zoe: I'll run a dedupe audit across service-* rules. Proposal: set dedupe default to 9m for metric flaps, but wire an escalation rule: if suppressed events >= 4 in 90m, force a page. Will validate in staging Thurs.

Priya: I'll update the incident runbook and paging doc: P0/P1 pages always; P2 -> ticket unless has customer-impact tag. Add a suppression review checklist to the runbook PR. PR by Wed.

Maya: can someone add a simple smoke harness pre-rollout? e.g. replay 2x baseline spikes and confirm pages still happen for sustained failures. Example: 

```
# generate spike: 150 concurrent requests
seq 1 150 | xargs -n1 -P50 curl -s https://staging/cache/health || echo spike
```

Ken: I'll run that against staging and paste logs.

oncall-bot: created task INFR-2872 "Cache alerts: thresholds + suppression" assigned to Ken, due 2026-04-02.

Zoe: implementation note: changing dedupe needs an alert-exporter config bump. I'll coordinate with infra-deploy and include a small integration test to simulate flaps.

Priya: timeline recap: Ken thresholds done by 2026-04-02; Zoe dedupe tests Thu; Priya runbook Wed. Add verification notes to the task before close.

Ken: will include dashboard links and canary results. Quick ask: can we add an automated monitor that checks suppressed->true positive ratio and auto-reverts suppression if ratio > 0.2 in 24h?

Zoe: +1 on auto-revert safeguard. I'll add it to the dedupe task as a gating rule.

Maya: good. Owners and dates confirmed. I'll notify PM and Support and tag @incident-review for visibility. Closing thread.
